A '''blaze''' in [[Matcha Flavoured]] drops {{ItemLink|Fire Charge|fire charges}} instead of blaze rods. Blaze rods are renamed {{ItemLink|Stabilized Estus}} in the pack and are crafted rather than dropped.

== Drops ==
{{Data/Loot/minecraft/entities/blaze}}
A blaze killed by a player drops 2–4 fire charges, plus 0–1 per level of Looting.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/entities/blaze.json}}</ref> Blazes don't drop {{ItemLink|Raw Estus}}, because they aren't undead.

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|1.03|Blaze drops nerfed slightly.}}
{{History line|1.10|Blazes no longer drop Raw Estus, since they aren't undead.}}
}}

== Trivia ==
* The blaze spawn egg is used as the base item for the [[Nazar]].
